scene: You grab the swinging paper crane and swoop over a rooftop garden.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view along a grassy rooftop terrace. Far left bubbles a tier-spouting marble fountain. Center, hanging from a giant creased paper crane up high, flies the girl clutching its folded legs with her sketchbook tucked secure. Right sits a bronze robot sipping tea. Far right stands a domed glass greenhouse with open vent.
shown: A tier-spouting marble fountain sits on the grass at the far left
An elderly robotic gardener sips tea beside a table on the right
